title: connect to both 670g and libre
symptom: User wants to connect xDrip to both a 670g pump (pump only) and a Libre sensor, possibly sending Libre readings to the pump.
evidence_quote: As long as there's no data multiplexer in xDrip, I'm afraid you've got to use two individual devices (smartphones) - one talking to the pump via the CNL stick, the other one running LibreLink, each one with their own xDrip.
